market.what: amine hardener in wind-blade epoxy systems, world (whole blade epoxy system ~$1.2-1.5B)
market.method: 165 GW x ~3 t epoxy system/MW (est.; sources say up to 4.25) = ~495 kt x ~25% hardener = ~124 kt x ~$4/kg (est.)

value.logic: 165 GW x ~7 t blade/MW = ~1.16 Mt/yr made recyclable x ~$300/t end-of-life value ($150 avoided landfill/kiln + $150 recovered glass/resin, est.) = ~$0.35B/yr; plus ~10% plant scrap now
value.revenue_logic: ~2% of 124 kt wind hardener = 2.5 kt x ~$8/kg premium = ~$20M (or license to resin maker)
value.margin_logic: specialty amine: 2-3 step from cheap ketone/aminocyclohexanol, sells at ~2x commodity hardener

trend.drivers: wind build-out (165 GW 2025, record); landfill bans (DE, NL, AT, FI); France rotor recyclability rules; OEM zero-waste pledges
trend.deadline: France: 55% of rotor mass recyclable for permits after 1 Jan 2025

competition.notes: Siemens Gamesa RecyclableBlade ~100 units by 2025; all Swancor resin to SGRE recyclable from 2026; Vestas pushes solvolysis for any epoxy (threat)

lab.synth: 3-5 step custom: protected aminocyclohexanol + ketalization + deprotection; 3 variants x 100 g for panels
lab.test: DSC Tg (ASTM D3418), DMA (ASTM D7028), infusion viscosity/pot life, GF laminate ILSS (ASTM D2344), mild-acid digestion mass loss
lab.logic: synth 9 wk + cure/mechanics/digestion 5 wk; synth $20k + composites lab tests ~$20k (est.)

sale.gates: DNV resin type approval 1-2 yrs; OEM coupon + subcomponent + full blade test (IEC 61400-23) 2-3 yrs; earlier sales in sports/marine composites
